signatures.description: Implement a dependency-free Node 20 Verkle commitment scheme using Pedersen commitments over BLS12-381 G1 with the inner-product argument: leaf commitments for a 256-leaf vector, opening proofs at arbitrary indices, and aggregation of many openings into one proof whose Fiat-Shamir challenges are derived from the full transcript (commitment, evaluation points, values, proof tape). The verifier must reject truncated tapes, non-canonical scalars, mismatched G1 affine/projective encodings, and any proof whose challenges omit the commitment or the evaluation point, while group arithmetic must avoid data-dependent branching on scalars. Acceptance is byte-exact agreement with reference vectors, rejection of a mutated transcript in every field position, and 256-leaf multiproof generation plus verification in under one second.
